steps.description: Privacy Operations verifies the requestor's identity within 5 business days of receiving the Right to Erasure request.

evidence.quote: Privacy Operations must verify the requestor's identity within 5 business days

steps.description: Data Engineering maps all systems and data stores containing the customer's personal data.

evidence.quote: Data Engineering must map all systems and data stores containing the customer's personal data

steps.description: If the customer is under an active contract, Legal confirms deletion does not breach contract obligations before any deletion proceeds.

evidence.quote: If the customer is subject to an active contract, Legal must confirm that deletion does not breach contract obligations before any deletion proceeds

steps.description: Data Engineering executes deletion across all mapped systems within 30 days of the verified request date.

evidence.quote: Data Engineering must execute deletion across all mapped systems within 30 days of the verified request date
Legal review must be completed before Data Engineering begins deletion execution

steps.description: If personal data resides in a backup system, the backup is marked for deletion at the next scheduled rotation cycle.

evidence.quote: If personal data resides in a backup system, the backup is marked for deletion at the next scheduled rotation cycle

steps.description: Privacy Operations sends a written deletion confirmation to the customer upon completion.

evidence.quote: Privacy Operations must send a written deletion confirmation to the customer upon completion
